customer_context.current_workflow: Adjusters manually inspect claim forms, policies, endorsements, photographs, and prior notes across multiple systems.
customer_context.problem_statement: Eligible property claims take an average of 18 minutes to assess because the evidence needed for routing decisions is distributed across multiple systems.

decision.user_decision: Decide whether an eligible claim can be fast-tracked or requires manual review.
decision.action_after_decision: Route the claim to the appropriate queue and record the supporting rationale.

in_scope: Surface policy evidence relevant to the claim
Escalate missing or conflicting evidence to manual review
out_of_scope: Remove the adjuster's final decision authority

discover.owner: Forward Deployed Engineer and Claims Operations Lead
discover.deliverable: Observed workflow, bounded problem statement, and measurement baseline
discover.evidence: Twenty sampled claim journeys and confirmed handling-time data
discover.exit_criterion: The user, decision, action, friction, scope, baseline, and business owner are confirmed.

design.owner: Forward Deployed Architect and Claims Operations Lead
design.deliverable: Bounded AI-assisted claims workflow with human decision points
design.evidence: Approved workflow showing recommendation, evidence citation, manual review, and prohibited actions
design.exit_criterion: The customer approves system boundaries, human authority, success criteria, and guardrails.

build.owner: AI Forward Deployed Engineer and Customer Integration Engineer
build.evidence: Representative claims produce traceable recommendations without executing prohibited actions
build.exit_criterion: The end-to-end slice passes functional checks and routes missing evidence to manual review.

run.owner: Technical Deployment Lead and Claims Operations Manager
run.deliverable: Controlled pilot with selected claims adjusters
run.evidence: Usage, handling time, override, availability, and incorrect-routing telemetry
run.exit_criterion: At least 200 eligible claims produce sufficient operational and quality evidence.

impact.deliverable: Scale, repair, pause, or exit recommendation
impact.evidence: Pilot results compared with the handling-time target and incorrect-fast-track guardrail
impact.exit_criterion: Leadership records an evidence-based deployment decision and accountable next action.

outcomes.technical_output: A claims-assistant workflow is deployed to the controlled pilot environment.
outcomes.customer_outcome: Adjusters receive relevant policy evidence and a traceable routing recommendation before making the final decision.
outcomes.business_impact: Average handling time for eligible claims decreases from 18 minutes to 11 minutes.

assumptions: The 1,200 weekly claims are eligible for the bounded workflow.
Policy and endorsement evidence is available in approved systems.
trade_offs: Manual review protects claim quality but limits maximum automation.
Evidence citation may increase latency but improves trust and auditability.
